inlines.v: SOMETIME, adverb [some and time.] 1. Once; formerly. That fair and warlike form, in which the majesty of buried Denmark did sometime march. 2. At one time or other hereafter. [Sometime is really a compound noun, and at is understood before it; at some time.]
